title: Coolant Tank Level — Low
description: Coolant tank level P033 = {val}%. Below recommended operating level (25%). Machine will halt at 5%.
probable_cause: Coolant consumption exceeds refill rate, or evaporation/drag-out.
remedy: Top up coolant tank. Check concentration and adjust. Investigate consumption rate if elevated.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
